title: Kernel-checked bounded gap-3 search for A^4 + B^4 = (B+3)^13 through B = 1,000,000
description: Lean 4.12.0 proves that no natural numbers A and B with B <= 1,000,000 satisfy A^4 + B^4 = (B+3)^13. Ten modular masks have kernel-checked soundness proofs; 2,000 separately compiled 500-value certificates cover B < 1,000,000, and the inclusive endpoint is checked separately. The bounded theorem uses only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. An exact-integer external checkpoint is independent evidence and is not a proof input. This does not prove the general Beal conjecture or discharge the remaining level-26 mathematical hypotheses. Methodology and build instructions: docs/FoundationsIntegratedV25_0_2.md.
